withdrawalSubstitution.rule: A selection on a withdrawn horse is deemed a selection on the immediately preceding race number; continue backward through other non-runners; predecessor of #1 wraps to the highest saddlecloth number.

withdrawalImpact.sportingProbability: Removal of competitors can increase #1's race win probability, but magnitude must be measured from a post-withdrawal market/model and is not assumed.
withdrawalImpact.pariMutuelCrowding: Every valid Lototurf ticket that selected withdrawn #2 Vintage Heat is transferred to #1 One More Night by rule. Therefore effective public share on #1 equals original share(#1)+original share(#2), subject to ticket-level details. This can materially increase expected jackpot sharing and offsets some or all sporting benefit from #2's withdrawal.

ev.interpretation: Previous break-even illustrations cannot be used as an execution signal until the effective post-withdrawal public share is bounded. For #1, effective public share must include transferred #2 selections. No post-withdrawal fair market is currently available, so the draw remains NO_PLAY.
